headline: Israeli Digital Bank Esh Prepares NIS 150 Million Capital Raise
summary: Esh Bank is preparing to raise 150 million Israeli shekels to fund the commercial launch of its digital banking services. Technology entrepreneur Nir Zuk is expected to join the investment round.
why: Esh Bank is a new digital challenger bank licensed by the Bank of Israel to foster competition in the domestic retail banking sector.

impacts.name: Esh Bank
impacts.why: Securing NIS 150 million in equity capital provides funding for commercial operations.
